verses.1: And the soldier went from Jerusalem to Jericho. From Jericho, he continued along the coast towards Mount Bethel.
verses.2: And he went out from the house of Eluzah, and crossed over to the border of Arki’at Taroth.
verses.3: And the tide rose to the border of Hifleti, all the way down to the border of Beit Horon. Its outlets were also covered by water.
verses.4: And the sons of Joseph were Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.5: And the boundaries of the children of Ephraim were their households. Their territory stretched from the easternmost part of Adar, all the way to Beth Horon on the west side of the Jordan River.
verses.6: And the sea border extended beyond what was expected. The border was traced from Tanach Shilo in the east, and it passed through Yanoha in the east as well.
verses.7: And from Yanohah, a woman came down, dressed in her robes. She touched Yiriyho, and then the river flowed out.
verses.8: From there, the border will extend for days. The river Kana will flow there. And its outlets will be the land of Mattah, the sons of Ephraim, for their families.
verses.9: And the distinguished cities were given to Ephraim within the territory of Benjamin. All those cities and their castles were given to him.
verses.10: And they did not destroy the Canaanites who lived in those lands. The Canaanites continued to live near Egypt until today. They became slaves.
